items.rationale: The failed indoor heating-pipe section is assessed under §2.4.3(a). Under §§7.1.5 and 7.1.9, allow only the necessary replacement length at the plain-copper rate, benchmarked at €96 for 6.4 m, with no chrome premium.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow standard copper fittings needed to reconnect the repaired section, not the designer finish. Four ordinary elbows at €10 each give €40.
Under §§7.1.5 and 7.1.9, allow these insofar as they were needed to reconnect the affected run, capped at five standard copper elbows at €20 each.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 limit this fitting to the ordinary copper equivalent needed for the reconnection, estimated at €20.
Minor repair fixings are covered under §7.1.7(c). Eight at about €1.10 each give a gross allowance of €8.80.
No 10 mm installation is identified in the repaired run, so §7.1.8(e) likely excludes these as dimensionally unmatched. If their use is substantiated, four ordinary clamps at €5 each would cost €20.
Section 7.1.7(c) allows ordinary supports used to reinstate the affected pipework. Four at €6 each give €24, consistent with the comparable repair.
Sections 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.9 cover customary labour for the like-for-like repair, not time spent on upgrades or new devices. Allow approximately 5.5 of the 6.75 billed hours at €90 gross per hour.
Sections 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.9 limit helper time to ordinary removal, reconnection and reinstatement. Allow approximately 4.5 of the 5.75 billed hours at €68 gross per hour.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cap the upgraded insulation at the cost of the pre-loss rock-wool equivalent. Six standard shells at €20 each give €120.
Section 7.1.7(c) allows binding wire to the extent used as a repair consumable, benchmarked at €9/kg for 2 kg. Section 7.1.8(e) excludes any quantity not attributable to the repair.
Section 7.1.9 excludes installations that were not present before the loss, so no allowance is due. The conditional figure is €85 gross for one sensor.
Section 7.1.9 excludes the valve because there was no pre-loss equivalent to reinstate. The conditional figure is €110 gross for one valve.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e) permit a lump sum for ordinary repair consumables, but not duplicates or materials used solely for the additions. Allow €33 for one lot.
Section 7.1.7(f) permits the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. One local plumbing call-out is benchmarked at €74 gross.

Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of the removed affected pipework and insulation, not waste from unrelated upgrades. Allow €60 for one small disposal lot, consistent with the comparable boiler-room repair.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes administrative or processing charges added to itemised labour and materials. The conditional figure is €15 gross for one fee.
